subject: Air freight quote to YYZ
body:
Hi,

Could you quote your fastest air freight option to YYZ (Toronto, CA), with an all-in price in EUR? Please arrange truck pickup from our site in 20462 (Hamburg), Germany, to the airport. The shipment is ready for pickup on 2026-11-28.

It’s 4 pieces of precision instruments, 81 kg gross and 0.67 cbm.

Mira Petersen
Nordlicht Audio

classification.reasoning: The customer requests an all-in air freight quote for a specific shipment to YYZ.
